title: YouTube Video Platform: Basic Architecture
description: Learn the fundamentals of designing youtube video platform. Understand requirements, constraints, and basic architecture.

data.text: Design a youtube video platform. Focus on understanding the core requirements, identifying key components, and creating a high-level architecture.

data.title: HLD vs LLD
data.text: High Level Design focuses on system architecture, scalability, and distributed systems. Low Level Design focuses on class diagrams and OOP. HLD answers 'what components' and 'how they communicate'; LLD answers 'what classes' and 'how they interact'.

data.title: Basic Architecture Components
data.code:
Core Components for YouTube Video Platform:

1. Client Layer
   - Web/Mobile apps
   - Load Balancer (NGINX/ALB)

2. API Gateway
   - Rate limiting
   - Authentication
   - Request routing

3. Service Layer
   - Business logic microservices
   - Service discovery
   - Inter-service communication

4. Data Layer
   - Primary database (SQL/NoSQL)
   - Cache (Redis)
   - Message queue (Kafka/RabbitMQ)
   - Object storage (S3)

5. Cross-cutting Concerns
   - Monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana)
   - Logging (ELK)
   - CI/CD pipeline

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: HLD focuses on distributed system architecture
Identify components: client, gateway, services, data
Document trade-offs for each technology choice
data.takeaway: YouTube Video Platform is a distributed system with client, gateway, services, and data layers. Start with requirements, then identify components and their interactions.
